sources.title: Thresh Build Guide: The Chain Warden of Botlane

passive.name: Damnation
passive.text: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

spells.name: Death Sentence
spells.text: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.

spells.name: Dark Passage
spells.text: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.

spells.name: Flay
spells.text: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.

spells.name: The Box
spells.text: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.

spikes.why: Thresh gains power for proactive trades and defensive peel.

spikes.at: Level 8 with Locket of the Iron Solari
spikes.why: Thresh benefits from its buffed early shield.

spikes.at: Q cooldown drops from 19 to 9 seconds
spikes.why: Thresh can attempt Death Sentence more often as its cooldown falls.

mistakes.value: Thresh loses potential crowd-control time by using Flay immediately after landing Death Sentence instead of waiting for its second tug.
